title: #DRCL midnight children
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: A loose reimagining of Bram Stoker's Dracula set at Whitby School in 1890s England, where Mina Murray, the first and only girl student and a skilled wrestler, is bullied by male classmates. When Count Dracula's arrival claims her friend Lucy Westenra, recast as a young man who is Lucy by night, Mina joins the boys to fight it (Viz blurb; Wikipedia; Anime News Network).
life_message: Courage and loyalty belong to whoever shows them, and people should be seen as who they truly are.

folkways.japan: A Japanese reworking of a Victorian English novel, adding a Japanese exchange student and the manga tradition of gender-crossing characters, described here as context.
